what: Vertical covers stand like a fan spread out on a distant lower axis and turn one slot every 4s. The center one stays upright, each step away tilts 14° more, and the inner panels sag down by 12%, 45% and 100% (the second and third go outward by 15% and 50%). Can also be dragged to flip. Merch, cover and poster display

options.step: Extra tilt angle per step (deg), default 14
options.interval: Interval before moving to the next cell (s), default 4
options.speed: Cell switch duration (sec), default .5 — 0 means instant
options.--fx-width: Center column width (css variable), default max(17.5em, 20vw)
options.[data-fx-part=card]: One per cell — the tilting outer plate
options.[data-fx-part=face]: Inside card — the sagging inner panel (cover image)
